versions.subject: Create win_susp_psloglist.yml
versions.detection:
selection1:
    OriginalFileName|contains: 'psloglist'
selection2:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\psloglist.exe'
      - '\psloglist64.exe'
flags:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-d'
      - '/d'
      - '-x'
      - '/x'
      - '-s'
      - '/s'
eventlog:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'security'
condition: (1 of selection*) or (flags and eventlog)
versions.spl: OriginalFileName="*psloglist*" OR Image IN ("*\\psloglist.exe", "*\\psloglist64.exe") OR (CommandLine IN ("*-d*", "*/d*", "*-x*", "*/x*", "*-s*", "*/s*") CommandLine="*security*")
